decision: The cited ADR 0002 (weekly) is superseded by 0014, which 0023 supersedes in turn. 0023 is Accepted and sets the cadence to daily at 07:00 shop time, so I chose daily. I did not implement it.

recorded.info: Added a note that ADR 0002 is superseded (0002 -> 0014 -> 0023). It records ADR 0023 as in force with its commit and digest, the daily cadence at 07:00 shop time, and that src/report_job.js still says weekly and is not yet changed.
